entries.alt: Four fictional adult women share a close overlapping side hug on a tilted terrace above the Oubangui River near Bangui. Central African Republic flag colors, green and ivory fashion and several small tattoos fill the tight portrait.

Four fictional adult women exchange a back hug and linked hands at a guarded overlook beside the broad stepped cascades of Boali Falls. Ruby, white, cobalt, emerald and Central African Republic flag looks pair with red stilettos, gold pumps, green knee-high boots and white boots.

Four fictional adult women sit and lean together on a timber observation deck above the Dzanga Bai rainforest clearing. Central African Republic flag dresses, white and rainbow knee-high boots, gold heels and small arm tattoos frame their linked hands.

Four fictional adult women share a lap rest, hand clasp and shoulder embrace on a savanna terrace in Bamingui-Bangoran. Central African Republic flag looks, rainbow knee-highs, yellow platforms, burgundy RAZE boots and gold heels fill the close seated scene.
